status: frozen preprocessing-only development contract; no predictive fitting or target selection
train_rule: entry strictly before January 1 of prediction year AND label_end strictly before that date
later_rows_rule: entry within prediction calendar year; previously examined development observations, not a final holdout
imputation: Median of observed transformed training values per numerical column. Preserve a missing flag for every numerical column before filling. A column missing throughout training contributes no numerical signal.
scaling: Subtract mean and divide by population standard deviation of imputed transformed training values, ddof=0. Use scale 1 for constant columns.
categorical: One binary column per industry category observed in training, in sorted order. Unseen or missing later categories encode as all zero and are recorded in diagnostics.
constant_columns: Remove columns with no variation in the encoded training table; apply the same saved mask later. Retain source missingness and dropped-column names in diagnostics.
transforms: No clipping, winsorization, learned target transform or outcome-driven feature selection. Fit medians, means, scales, category vocabulary and constant mask only on training inputs; read no numerical targets.
reuse: Re-fit for each chronological fold and every later inner validation fold; never re-fit on the later evaluation rows.
scope_limits: Preprocessing does not certify extraction accuracy, point-in-time vendor publication, valid neural-network tuning folds, investment performance or an independent final evaluation.
